title: Bubble tea shop in Washington, DC

items.name: Articles of organization (DC LLC)
items.agency: DC Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection, Corporations Division
items.quote: To register domestic limited liability company in the District, customer shall deliver articles of organization form DLC-1 to the Superintendent for filing

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
items.feeQuote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: DC tax registration
items.agency: DC Office of Tax and Revenue
items.quote: All applicants for a Basic Business License must be registered and in good standing with the DC Office of Tax and Revenue.

items.name: Certified food protection manager
items.quote: All applicants for a Basic Business License for a Food Services Business, must have a Certified Food Protection Manager

items.name: Unemployment insurance employer registration
items.quote: Any business that has employees working in the District of Columbia is required to register online at essp.does.dc.gov

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.quote: Plans are to be submitted: before construction of a food establishment, before conversion of an existing structure to a food establishment;

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy
items.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy (C of O) verifies that the use of a building, structure, or land in the District complies with the legal and safety standards

items.name: Basic Business License (food services)
items.agency: DC Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection
items.quote: Anyone engaging in business activity within the District is required to be licensed in accordance with the specific activity conducted (e.g., convenience stores, home improvement contractors, residential rentals, restaurants).

items.name: Building permit
items.quote: Building permits and final inspections are required.
